_README: Copy this to %USERPROFILE%\.cham-hq\config.json and fill it in. Never commit the filled-in version - it holds real secrets.
_thread_url: Open the Chạm group chat on instagram.com in a browser and copy the address bar. It looks like https://www.instagram.com/direct/t/17845...
_anthropic_api_key: From console.anthropic.com -> API keys. This bills per use, separate from your Claude subscription. A nightly wrap costs a fraction of a cent.
_firebase_key_path: The service account JSON you downloaded from Firebase. Move it here so it does not sit in Downloads.
_scroll_passes: How far back up the thread to scroll before reading. Raise it if busy days get cut off.
_headed: true shows the browser window while it works. Instagram is more suspicious of hidden windows, so leave this on unless it causes trouble.
